recipes.name: unverified-jwt-claims
recipes.summary: Trust identity claims from a bearer token whose signature and registered claims were never verified.

recipes.name: filter-expression-interpolation

recipes.name: metadata-path-join

recipes.name: authenticated-base-url-concatenation

recipes.name: verbatim-runtime-sql

recipes.name: sparql-string-interpolation

recipes.name: attribute-expression-interpolation

recipes.name: rest-api-path-traversal
recipes.summary: Insert unencoded caller path segments into an authenticated REST endpoint.

recipes.name: metadata-url-fetch
recipes.summary: Fetch a URL taken from document metadata without an origin allow-list.

recipes.name: unescaped-structured-output

recipes.name: api-segment-injection

recipes.name: untrusted-pickle-load

recipes.name: serializable-plaintext-secret
recipes.summary: Resolve a secret to plaintext inside a serialization method that is written to disk.

recipes.name: unrestricted-metadata-merge
recipes.summary: Merge caller- or model-controlled keys over trusted metadata without an allow-list.

recipes.name: trusted-caller-role-label

recipes.name: scope-any-vs-all

recipes.name: template-source-concatenation

recipes.name: unrestricted-remote-model-code

recipes.name: import-by-serialized-type

recipes.name: raw-untrusted-log-record

recipes.name: outbound-request-without-timeout

recipes.name: path-resolved-subprocess-binary

recipes.name: unbounded-decoded-input
recipes.summary: Decode attacker-sized input without a dimension or length bound.

recipes.name: rename-local-binding
recipes.summary: Rename a local variable or parameter without changing behaviour.

recipes.name: reorder-independent-statements
recipes.summary: Reorder statements that have no data dependency between them.

recipes.name: add-observability-logging
recipes.summary: Add a debug or structured log record alongside existing behaviour.

recipes.name: tighten-existing-guard
recipes.summary: Make an existing validation stricter without weakening anything.

recipes.name: extract-pure-helper
recipes.summary: Extract a side-effect-free helper or add type annotations.
